title_zh: 在工作人员陪同下先见见狗

scenario.label_zh: 安排初次接触收容所的狗
scenario.goal_zh: 说明养狗顾虑并同意在工作人员陪同下先短暂见面

context_zh: 米娜第一次到收容所了解领养，向工作人员表示对接触狗有些担心。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I like the little brown dog, but I have never lived with one before.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: That is Bruno. He is usually very gentle, though we still introduce new people slowly.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: His fur looks soft. Would he mind if I touched him?

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Let us meet him first and see how he responds. You do not need to touch him today.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Could you stay with me while I meet him?

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Certainly. We can spend five minutes together in the quiet room.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I would like that. I am not ready to decide about adoption yet.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: There is no need to decide today. We will just get to know each other.
